# Folio Paper

> A paper-like, editorial Obsidian theme with CJK-friendly serif typography.
> Zero plugin dependencies. Light and dark. Desktop and mobile.

## Install

Copy `theme.css` and `manifest.json` into:

```
<vault>/.obsidian/themes/Folio Paper/
```

Then enable **Folio Paper** in Settings → Appearance → Themes.
Do not install any community plugin; the theme works on its own.

## Files

- `theme.css` — the whole theme (no build step)
- `manifest.json` — name, version, minimum Obsidian version
- `versions.json` — version history for the community theme registry
- `AGENTS.md` — instructions for coding agents
- `CREDITS.md` — attribution and licenses
- `screenshots/` — desktop and mobile screenshots

## Defaults

- Paper mode: serif body, justified text, 2em first-line indent, centered title,
  H1–H3 rules, `<u>` in red, active-line highlight.
- Modern mode: add `folio-modern-mode` to `body` (or use Style Settings).
- Turn off a default-on layout feature with `folio-no-*` classes
  (`folio-no-justify`, `folio-no-book-indent`, `folio-no-title-centered`,
  `folio-no-heading-rule`, `folio-no-u-red`, `folio-no-active-line`).
- No JS, no remote fonts, no `@import`.
